newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING real estate unit in NLG 150 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: ING real estate unit in NLG 150 mln deal.

text.p: Dutch financial services group ING Groep NV said its ING Vastgoed real estate unit had acquired a 50 percent stake in the World Trade Centre (WTC) office complex in Amsterdam in a deal worth 150 million guilders.
ING Vastgoed acquired the stake from FGH Bank, a unit of Dutch insurer Aegon NV. ING said its gross rental yield on the investment would be about 7.5 percent.
The WTC has 100,000 square metres of floorspace, shops, restaurants, a conference centre and parking for 1,164 cars.
ING Vastgoed and the other 50 percent stakeholder Kantoren Fonds Nederland -- a unit of the Dutch civil servants' pension fund ABP -- are preparing to renovate and expand the WTC.
ING said the complex could be expanded to add another 40,000 square metres of space.
